page_title: ANG 0-2 LIL | Angers v Lille 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Jonathan David (Lille) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.

90+1' Jordan Lefort (Angers) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Lucas Chevalier!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Osame Sahraoui (Lille) in, Mathias Fernandez-Pardo out.
87' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:4.
84' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benjamin Andre (Lille) was quite harsh and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Angers.
78' Substitution. Andre Gomes leaves the pitch and is replaced by Nabil Bentaleb (Lille).
77' Bruno Genesio is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ethan Mbappe suffers an injury and Mitchel Bakker (Lille) comes on.
75' Total attempts – 4:8.
72' It will be a substitution. Ethan Mbappe (Lille) is ready to enter the pitch as Hakon Arnar Haraldsson walks off.
72' Here's the change. Chuba Akpom leaves the pitch and Aissa Mandi (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
71' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Yassine Belkhdim is replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
71' Substitution. Carlens Arcus is replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
68' The corner is swung in but Angers can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' RED CARD! Bafode Diakite (Lille) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem. He can have an early bath.
65' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
63' Angers failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' That's the end of the game for Florent Hanin, who is replaced by Jacques Ekomie (Angers).
62' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Zinedine Ould Khaled and he is replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
61' It's time for a substitution. Farid El Melali (Angers) comes on in place of Jim Allevinah.
61' Yellow card. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
60' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

59' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
58' It's a yellow card for Thomas Meunier (Lille).
57' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
56' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
56' Angers get a corner.
54' 30:70 – the ratio of ball possession.

50' 0 - 2 Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Chuba Akpom, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:2.
49' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jonathan David (Lille) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Yahia Fofana was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
48' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson flights in the free kick and the ball finds the head of Alexsandro (Lille), whose excellent bullet header goes low inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
45+1' Lille are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Himad Abdelli (Angers) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Lille.
43' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Esteban Lepaul (Angers) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.
37' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sends a chip pass into the box, but Yahia Fofana is quickest to intercept the ball.
35' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
33' The resulting corner from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
30' Jonathan David (Lille) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
28' Ismaily (Lille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Ismaily (Lille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
25' Thomas Meunier (Lille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It's a throw-in for Lille.

23' Chuba Akpom (Lille) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly over the bar. The goalkeeper was lucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
21' Lille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
18' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Bafode Diakite (Lille) for his blatant foul.
17' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
15' Jim Allevinah (Angers) gets inside the box and tries to beat Lucas Chevalier with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
14' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
12' Thomas Meunier (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

8' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

7' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lille are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Himad Abdelli (Angers) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
2' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
